text: Three days before the repair, on 13 September 2026, the ShortsOS owner ratified one capability, its real produce, review and publish workflow, for a public claim. One of the six broken records belonged to that very capability. On a fresh copy of the code, that broken record silently pushed the capability back to candidate status. A candidate, in this governance vocabulary, is real work that has not been cleared for a public claim. The team logged the problem as a live regression of a ratified decision, not as a cosmetic data issue. A check that breaks loudly tends to get fixed quickly; one that quietly lowers a claim can sit unnoticed.
